title: The view ascribes experience, not thought, to basic matter

statements.text: The panpsychism defended today is panexperientialism. It ascribes extremely simple experience to fundamental entities, not thoughts, hopes or beliefs, and the picture of electrons driven by existential angst is a caricature nobody defends.

sources.quote: it is panexperientialist forms of panpsychism that are taken seriously in contemporary analytic philosophy
Panpsychism is often caricatured as the view that fundamental physical entities like electrons have thoughts
